name: kneeling push up to child pose
description: A knee push-up that ends by sitting your hips back into child pose, building the chest and giving the back a stretch.
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to the start.
Push your hips back onto your heels and reach your arms forward into child pose.
Return to the start and repeat.
